_readme: floor_pct: the barrier FAILS if a platform's live coverage drops below this.
A platform ABSENT from this file fails the barrier outright: onboarding a platform now
REQUIRES declaring its expected image coverage here (or imageless_at_source with a reason).
Raise floors when a fix lands; never lower one to clear a red — a drop is an incident.

amlakalahsa.note: Declared 2026-09-13. Went production-searchable 2026-09-12 without a baseline row. 260 of 262 rows carry an image on the only snapshot taken so far, so the floor follows this file's own today-minus-about-three convention; it is a first observation, not a long trend.

aqaralsaudia.note: Declared 2026-09-19 (routine-3). Went production-searchable without a baseline row (ops_incident #231, filed 2026-09-13, named only wasalt/azdad/amlakalahsa at the time). Only 16 active rows — TINY and volatile like azdad at its own declaration (23 rows): one listing is 6.25 points. Floor set well below the single 100% observation for the same reason azdad's own note gives; raise once the platform is large enough for a percentage to mean something.

azdad.note: Declared 2026-09-13. Went production-searchable without a baseline row and failed the onboarding gate for days. The floor is deliberately well below today_pct because this platform is TINY and therefore VOLATILE: at 23 active rows a single listing is 4.3 points, and the seven observed snapshots run 76.0 / 76.0 / 76.9 / 78.3 / 79.2 / 86.4 / 87.0. 72 sits one listing below the lowest figure ever observed, so the gate fires on a real capture regression and not on ordinary churn. Raise it once the platform is large enough for a percentage to mean something.

rakez.note: Declared 2026-09-19 (routine-3). Went production-searchable without a baseline row and failed the onboarding gate for days (ops_incident #231, filed 2026-09-13, named only wasalt/azdad/amlakalahsa at the time — rakez was undeclared and unnoticed until this run). 3,908 rows is a large enough sample for a percentage to mean something; floor follows this file's own today-minus-about-three convention on a single observation.

suwar.note: Declared 2026-09-19 (routine-3). Went production-searchable without a baseline row (ops_incident #231). 96 active rows — small enough that a single listing losing its photo is ~1 point, so the floor is set meaningfully below the one observation taken so far rather than following the today-minus-about-three convention verbatim, matching the reasoning already used for azdad (a tiny, volatile platform).
